summary.title: Restore simple loop spinner and text
changes: The loop indicator now shows a standard spinner and the word "looping" when active.
The custom animated dashed capsule spinner was removed and replaced with a static capsule border.
Pull-down-to-force shows "Forcing loop…" with a spinner while forcing, and an arrow with "Pull down to force loop" when.
Forcing-loop display now remains visible for at least one second.
The home dashboard gains top padding while forcing the loop, with a short animation to reveal the indicator.
